bin_seed.help_text: Set a fixed seed for CONCOCT (used with --no_gpu).

concoct_min_contig.help_text: Minimum threshold for contig size (bp). The lowest accepted value is 500.

maxbin2_min_contig.help_text: Minimum threshold for contig size (bp) for MaxBin2. The lowest accepted value is 500.

metabat_min_contig.help_text: Legacy metaBAT option (metaBAT is no longer run). Still counted when choosing the pre-binning contig-length filter, which uses the smallest of --maxbin2_min_contig, --concoct_min_contig and this value. The lowest accepted value is 1500.

maxbin_markers.help_text: MaxBin2 marker set: 40 (universal bacteria + archaea) or 107 (present in >95% of bacteria). MaxBin2 treats any value other than 40 as 107, so the inherited default of 140 runs the 107-gene set.

metabat1.help_text: Legacy option, no effect: metaBAT1/2 are no longer part of the binner set.

keep_unbinned.help_text: Keep CONCOCT's unbinned contigs in its bin set (only relevant with --no_gpu).

semibin2_environment.help_text: Pretrained habitat model for SemiBin2's single_easy_bin --environment (skips self-supervised training).

metacat_wheel_url.help_text: Path (or URL) to the MetaCAT pip wheel to install at runtime (no bioconda/biocontainers package exists yet). Defaults to a pre-downloaded local copy so the task doesn't depend on outbound network access.

no_gpu.help_text: Run without a GPU: replace comebin with CONCOCT, so Binette reconciles SemiBin2 + MetaCAT + MaxBin2 + CONCOCT (the best GPU-free combination in the 18-sample benchmark: 96% of the full 6-binner HQ-bin total, vs comebin + SemiBin2 + MetaCAT + MaxBin2 by default). Use when you cannot submit to a GPU queue.
